columns.name: ano
columns.description: The year associated with the records; all rows are for 2023, shown in four-digit year format.

columns.name: edicao
columns.description: An edition number for the selection process, recorded as integer codes 1 or 2; the profile does not specify what each edition denotes.

columns.name: etapa
columns.description: A numeric stage code for the selection process; every row has code 4.

columns.name: ds_etapa
columns.description: The text label for the stage, shown as “CHAMADA REGULAR” for all rows.

columns.name: codigo_ies
columns.description: A numeric identifier for the higher education institution (IES), paired with its name in `nome_ies` and abbreviation in `sigla_ies`; despite being stored as a decimal number, it functions as a code.

columns.name: nome_ies
columns.description: The institution’s name, paired with the numeric institution identifier in `codigo_ies` and abbreviation in `sigla_ies`.

columns.name: sigla_ies
columns.description: The institution’s abbreviation or short name, paired with the institution identifier in `codigo_ies` and name in `nome_ies`.

columns.name: uf_ies
columns.description: The two-letter Brazilian state abbreviation for the institution’s state, such as RJ or PR.

columns.name: codigo_campus
columns.description: A numeric identifier for the campus; it is a code rather than a measured quantity, despite being stored as a decimal number.

columns.name: nome_campus
columns.description: The campus name or unit designation, such as “Cidade Universitária” or “UNIDADE SEDE”.

columns.name: uf_campus
columns.description: The two-letter Brazilian state abbreviation for the campus’s state, such as RJ or PR.

columns.name: municipio_campus
columns.description: The municipality where the campus is located, with values such as Rio de Janeiro and Niterói.

columns.name: codigo_curso
columns.description: A numeric identifier for the course; it is a code rather than a measured quantity, despite being stored as a decimal number.

columns.name: nome_curso
columns.description: The course name, with examples including MEDICINA, PSICOLOGIA, and ADMINISTRAÇÃO.

columns.name: grau
columns.description: The course degree or program type, recorded as Bacharelado, Licenciatura, Tecnológico, or Área Básica de Ingresso (ABI).

columns.name: turno
columns.description: The course’s shift or attendance mode, recorded as Integral, Noturno, Matutino, Vespertino, or EaD.

columns.name: ds_periodicidade
columns.description: The course’s periodicity, recorded as Anual or Semestral.

columns.name: tp_cota
columns.description: A string category code associated with a quota type; observed values include “D”, “DD”, “PPI”, and “PPID” (some are space-padded). It is null in about 58% of rows, and the profile does not provide expansions for the codes.

columns.name: tipo_mod_concorrencia
columns.description: A single-letter category code for the competition modality, with observed values A, B, L, and V; the profile does not define these codes.

columns.name: mod_concorrencia
columns.description: The competition modality described in text, including “Ampla concorrência” and longer descriptions of eligibility categories.

columns.name: qt_vagas_concorrencia
columns.description: The number of places available for the competition modality, recorded as an integer from 1 to 90.

columns.name: percentual_bonus
columns.description: The bonus percentage when present; the only observed non-null value is 5. It is null in about 99.96% of rows.

columns.name: peso_l
columns.description: A weight for the component identified by the suffix L, recorded as a number from 1 to 5, including 2.5.

columns.name: peso_ch
columns.description: A weight for the component identified by the suffix CH, recorded as a number from 1 to 5, including 1.5 and 2.5.

columns.name: peso_cn
columns.description: A weight for the component identified by the suffix CN, recorded as a number from 1 to 5, including 1.5.

columns.name: peso_m
columns.description: Numeric weight associated with mathematics (M), based on the column name. Values range from 1 to 5, including half-unit increments, and appear to be weighting factors rather than scores.

columns.name: peso_r
columns.description: Numeric weight associated with the essay/writing area (R), based on the column name. Values are integers from 1 to 5 and appear to be weighting factors rather than scores.

columns.name: nota_minima_l
columns.description: Minimum or required score for Linguagens (L), recorded as a decimal number on a range of 0 to 500. Values such as 0, 0.01, and 1 occur, but the profile does not establish whether they are special codes or literal scores.

columns.name: nota_minima_ch
columns.description: Minimum or required score for Ciências Humanas (CH), recorded as a decimal number on a range of 0 to 500. Values such as 0, 0.01, and 1 occur, but their special meaning, if any, is not specified by the profile.

columns.name: nota_minima_cn
columns.description: Minimum or required score for Ciências da Natureza (CN), recorded as a decimal number on a range of 0 to 500. Values such as 0, 0.01, and 1 occur, but the profile does not identify them as codes.

columns.name: nota_minima_m
columns.description: Minimum or required score for mathematics (M), recorded as a decimal number on a range of 0 to 500. Values such as 0, 0.01, and 1 occur, but their meaning beyond the recorded values is not established.

columns.name: nota_minima_r
columns.description: Minimum or required score for the essay/writing area (R), recorded as a decimal number from 0.01 to 500. The profile does not indicate any special interpretation for the low values.

columns.name: media_minima
columns.description: Minimum or required average score, based on the column name and its numeric values. It is recorded as a decimal number from 0 to 500; the profile does not specify how the average is calculated.

columns.name: cpf
columns.description: Candidate CPF, a Brazilian personal identification number, stored as text. The examples are masked, with X characters replacing some digits; the profile does not show an unmasked format.

columns.name: inscricao_enem
columns.description: ENEM registration identifier stored as text. Example values contain X characters masking part of the identifier.

columns.name: inscrito
columns.description: Candidate's name, stored as text; the frequent values are personal names. No special encoding is indicated.

columns.name: sexo
columns.description: Candidate sex category encoded as F or M. These are the only observed values; the profile provides no further category labels.

columns.name: dt_nascimento
columns.description: Candidate birth year, stored as a four-digit integer in YYYY format. Observed years range from 1946 to 2009; this is a year, not a full date.

columns.name: uf_candidato
columns.description: Candidate's state (UF), represented by a two-letter state abbreviation. The 27 distinct values and examples such as RJ and SP are consistent with Brazilian state abbreviations.

columns.name: municipio_candidato
columns.description: Candidate's municipality, stored as a city or municipality name; examples include Rio de Janeiro and São Paulo. The profile shows 3,736 distinct names.

columns.name: opcao
columns.description: An option or choice number, stored as an integer with observed values 1 and 2. The profile does not define what the two options represent.

columns.name: nota_l
columns.description: Candidate's score in Linguagens (L), recorded as a decimal number from 0 to 784.2. The profile does not specify the score scale or units beyond the numeric values.

columns.name: nota_ch
columns.description: Candidate's score in Ciências Humanas (CH), recorded as a decimal number from 0 to 827.2. The profile does not specify the score scale or units beyond the numeric values.

columns.name: nota_cn
columns.description: Candidate's score in Ciências da Natureza (CN), recorded as a decimal number from 0 to 847.2. A value of 0 occurs, but the profile does not establish whether it is a score or a special code.

columns.name: nota_m
columns.description: Candidate's mathematics (M) score, recorded as a decimal number from 0 to 985.7. A value of 0 occurs, but the profile does not establish whether it is a score or a special code.

columns.name: nota_r
columns.description: Candidate's essay/writing (R) score, recorded as a decimal number from 40 to 1,000. The observed values are relatively few and include round values such as 920 and 880.

columns.name: nota_l_com_peso
columns.description: Linguagens (L) score with a weight applied, as indicated by “com_peso” in the name. It ranges from 0 to 3,643.5, higher than the unweighted nota_l range; the profile does not specify the exact calculation.

columns.name: nota_ch_com_peso
columns.description: Ciências Humanas (CH) score with a weight applied, as indicated by “com_peso” in the name. It ranges from 0 to 3,629.5; the profile does not specify the exact calculation.

columns.name: nota_cn_com_peso
columns.description: Ciências da Natureza (CN) score with a weight applied, as indicated by “com_peso” in the name. It ranges from 0 to 3,549; the profile does not specify the exact calculation.

columns.name: nota_m_com_peso
columns.description: Mathematics (M) score with a weight applied, as indicated by “com_peso” in the name. It ranges from 0 to 4,567.5; the profile does not specify the exact calculation.

columns.name: nota_r_com_peso
columns.description: Pontuação da componente “R” com peso aplicado, conforme indicado pelo nome; os valores são numéricos decimais e variam de 40 a 4900. O perfil não identifica a unidade nem a escala.

columns.name: nota_candidato
columns.description: Pontuação numérica do candidato, entre 156,96 e 848,62; o perfil não especifica a unidade ou a escala.

columns.name: nota_corte
columns.description: Pontuação de corte numérica, entre 175,44 e 824,44; o perfil não especifica a unidade ou a escala.

columns.name: classificacao
columns.description: Posição de classificação do candidato, com valores inteiros de 1 a 6256; valores menores indicam posições mais altas na ordenação.

columns.name: aprovado
columns.description: Indica se o candidato foi aprovado: “S” significa sim e “N” significa não.

columns.name: matricula
columns.description: Situação da matrícula, indicada por uma das categorias: “PENDENTE”, “NÃO COMPARECEU”, “EFETIVADA”, “DOCUMENTACAO REJEITADA” ou “CANCELADA”.
